verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage documents a Batch Processing API for high-volume customer processing, plus asynchronous screening for high-volume scenarios. Bulk data export by type and date range (customers, cases, transactions, and more) is also documented. However, the batch capability appears only as a single-line pointer with no detail, and monitoring configuration and status endpoints are explicitly per single customer. missing for 10: documented Batch Processing API details (limits, job status, results), bulk case/alert decisioning or reassignment, bulk monitor/unmonitor operations, independent or hands-on corroboration.
